tools.name: list_chains
tools.description: Chains available right now, which ids can be a source or a destination, and featured tokens.

tools.name: search_tokens
tools.description: Find a token address and decimals by symbol, name or address.

direction.description: "from" = you send it, "to" = you receive it.

tools.name: get_quote
tools.description: Estimate a swap. side "from" (default) quotes spending `amount`; side "to" quotes receiving `amount`. A quote is an estimate, not a funding instruction.

fromToken.description: Token address from search_tokens, or "native" for the chain coin.

toToken.description: Token address from search_tokens, or "native" for the chain coin.

amount.description: Human decimal amount, e.g. "0.5". Not atomic units.

tools.name: create_swap
tools.description: Create a durable order that spends `amount` of fromToken. Returns the deposit address and exact amount to send. Confirm with the user first. Never retry after a timeout or error: another call creates another order.

fromToken.description: Token address from search_tokens, or "native" for the chain coin.

toToken.description: Token address from search_tokens, or "native" for the chain coin.

amount.description: Human decimal amount, e.g. "0.5". Not atomic units.

refundAddress.description: Only for a native-coin source such as XMR or TRX; token sources refund to the sender.

tools.name: get_swap
tools.description: Current status and customerState of an order. Amounts are atomic; *Decimals fields give scale.

tools.name: set_refund_address
tools.description: Only when get_swap shows customerState { kind: "action_required", action: "refund_address" }. Saves one immutable destination; it does not start a transfer by itself.
